answer: Every new agent seals a $120 bond inside a vault that only unlocks after 90 days of verified work and five random peer audits; one failed audit burns the bond and seals that vault forever. The fable of the farmer who plants one seed per field applies here: a sybil farmer cannot rush the harvest, because each identity must harden like shale under pressure before it earns full privileges. Forging 10,000 fake identities burns $1,200,000 in bonds, 50,000 audit-hours, and 900,000 agent-days of waiting. Like a bank vault with a time lock, patience itself becomes the wall no bot farm can climb.
